title: Free Night Awards Cancellation, No-Show and Membership Closure Terms
content:
These terms govern what becomes of Free Night Awards when a reservation they are on is cancelled or becomes a no-show, and when the Ashbury Rewards membership holding them is closed.

| Term | 25K | 35K | 40K | 50K | 85K | Any Hotel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The award returns to the account when its reservation is cancelled on or before the deadline | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A returned award whose expiry date has passed expires instead of becoming usable again | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The award covering the first night is lost when the reservation is cancelled after the deadline | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The award covering the first night is lost when the reservation becomes a no-show | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Top-off points come back when the award is released | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The award can be applied only while the membership is active | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Unused awards are lost when the membership is closed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Awards already applied to a future reservation survive the closure of the membership | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

The columns are the 25K Free Night Award, 35K Free Night Award, 40K Free Night Award, 50K Free Night Award, 85K Free Night Award and Any Hotel Free Night Award.

## Definitions

- **The deadline** is the cancellation deadline of the reservation; whether a cancellation was recorded on or before it, or after it, is shown on the reservation as its cancellation timing.
- **The first night** is the night of the reservation's arrival date.
- **Released** describes an award taken off its reservation and put back in the member's account.
- **Unused awards**, for closure, are awards standing issued in the account and not applied to any reservation.
